text:
Priya: spotted transient retry storm ap-south -> us-west around 02:07 UTC, lots of client retries and TLS handshake errors in a narrow window.
Dev: any config push around then?
Priya: control-plane released a route rewrite at 02:05 and we had CA bundle rotation starting ~02:06. overlap looks suspicious. Logs: `tls: handshake error: certificate expired` and `selected backend region=us-west latency=350ms`.
Ravi: I'll sweep certs and rotate any expired intermediates. Taking ownership, ETA 6h.
Sam: I'll own the incident-pattern analysis. Logging looks like a variant of previous route-flip + TLS jitter events. Will pull cluster traces and KV cache invalidation rates. ETA 72h.
Dev: I'll add a guard to control-plane: reject automated rewrites if a cert rotation job is in progress OR if regional selection changes >2% in 5m. Will open RFC and PR; planning canary tomorrow 07:30 UTC at 5%.
Priya: Action items: 1) Ravi cert sweep/rotation 2) Dev control-plane guard 3) Sam pattern write-up 4) Add dashboard + alert for per-region TLS error diff.
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-2379, severity=P3. Postmortem template: https://redwood/inci/INC-2026-2379/postmortem
Ravi: CA rotation PR: https://git.redwood/infra/ca-rotate/pull/520. Started phased rollout (10% -> 50% -> 100%) with health checks.
Dev: RFC opened: https://redwood/rfcs/route-guard-2026. PR incoming. Canary plan: 5% traffic, 20m watch, rollback on >0.8% cross-region 5xx.
Sam: Telemetry owners: please add per-route TLS error-rate + route-selection delta chart. Stub in Grafana: https://grafana/redwood/d/tls-route-diff-stub
Priya: Quick mitigation note: ops, if you see simultaneous control-plane rewrites and cert rotations, pause automated rewrites and escalate. I'm adding that to the runbook.
Dev: will add automated stop condition and a preflight check for cert-rotation state.
Sam: I'll include hypothesis about KV cache invalidation amplifying retries when route flips, and recommend shorter cache TTLs for route keys.
Priya: Scheduling 30m follow-up tomorrow 08:00 UTC to review rollouts and pattern findings. Please confirm owners add checklist to INC-2026-2379.
Ravi: Confirmed, will post rollout links as they progress.
Dev: Confirmed.
Sam: Confirmed.
Priya: Thanks all. Let's avoid doing control-plane rewrites during cert maintenance windows. :thumbsup:
